proposal.title: Open stg_events refactor PR
proposal.notes:
Split stg_events into three new source-aligned staging models, one per source (webhook feed, app database, and the third source). Keep stg_events as a thin union view on top so that the approximately 12 downstream models that select from it directly are not broken. Leave those downstream refs untouched for now and plan to migrate them one by one afterwards. Do not define any measures on top of the new staging models until the refactor lands. Tag Maya Lindqvist on the PR when it is opened. If it is cheap to capture, include compile-time numbers before and after as a proof point, but do not invest significant time in gathering them.

Due date: 'by Tuesday' from 2026-06-05 = 2026-06-09.
